subject: general
question: The famous Jhaveri sisters are associated with the _________classical dance form.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Manipuri.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Darshana Jhaveri, a classical Manipuri dancer,** research scholar and teacher is one of the four internationally renowned** Jhaveri sisters,** whose name has become synonymous with **Manipuri dance**.
 
• **The Manipuri Dance**, also referred to as the **Manipuri Raas Leela** is one of the eight major Indian classical dance forms, originating from the **state of Manipur.**
 
• It was in the reign of King Bhagyachandra that the popular Rasleela dances of **Manipur originated.**
 
• It is said, that this **18th-century philosopher king conceived** this complete dance form along with its **unique costume and music in a dream.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7682da33c42fb6a4f4dd8e2c8e41d5bb10e5b0f8cfa8ea23cd12191f3e5308c.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​****Odissi also referred to as Orissa** in old literature, is a major ancient Indian classical dance that origin in the Hindu temples of Odisha –** an eastern coastal state of India.**** **
 
• **Bharatanatyam** is a major form of Indian classical dance that** originated in Tamil Nadu. **
 
• **Kathak** is one of the eight major forms of Indian classical dance.**It is the classical dance form of Uttar Pradesh. **
